 2 M’sian Retirees, Teacher, Office Worker & Housewife Win Combined RM32.3mil Jackpot | WeirdKaya
 Local 17 Nov 2026 • 11:25 AM MYT WeirdKaya Community news hub for today's generation of Malaysians
 Five individuals from three different states became millionaires overnight and set the record of winning a combined RM32.31 million in jackpot prizes in October .
 According to a press statement by Magnum 4D, the five winners included two retirees, a housewife, an office worker, and a teacher.
 The biggest winner was a retiree from Jalan Alor, Kuala Lumpur, who bagged RM22,534,345 from a RM20 bet on Oct 27 with the winning numbers 2974 and 2493.
 Photo by WeirdKaya The statement revealed that he had been placing bets for the past 30 years without fail.
 As for the other four winners, they all won money after placing from RM10 bets, with their winnings stated below:
 Retiree from Klang: Won RM2,127,420 
 Office worker from Taman Pertama: Won RM2,236,598 
 Housewife from Boulevard, Miri: Won RM2,672,677 
 Teacher from Saratok: Won RM2,740,849 
 For illustration purposes only. Photo via Canva Magnum 4D also noted that all five winners shared one thing in common: they had chosen numbers which held significant meaning to them such as family birth dates and vehicle registration numbers.
